blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Bureau of Customs (BOC) Commissioner Ariel Nepomuceno will leave his post to lead the Bases Conversion and Development Authority (BCDA), in another shake-up of key government agencies under the Marcos administration. Nepomuceno confirmed that he would succeed Joshua Bingcang as BCDA president and CEO. The state-owned corporation is tasked with converting former military bases and other government properties into economic hubs.
